title: BreadBowl-Embed slots
change_summary: Index BreadBowl-Embed v1.3 as 16 routing rows per passage (256-d, inner product) and rerank candidates with the model's score() over stored value vectors. A CPU SciFact run is in the README.
bindings_note: Examples, docs, and a benchmark script. No C API or on-disk change. logosdb-mcp-server 1.4.5 only moves its logosdb range to ^1.6.0.
tagline: Embedded vector DB for AI agents and RAG
release_tagline: Index 16 routing vectors per passage, then rerank the stored values

highlights.name: 16 routing rows
highlights.desc: Each passage is 16 unit vectors, 256 dimensions, inner product.

highlights.name: model.score()
highlights.desc: Rerank reads the stored value vectors. The passage text is not encoded again.

highlights.name: SciFact
highlights.desc: CPU numbers in the README: nDCG@10, recall@100, size, latency.

install: pip install logosdb   ·   npm i logosdb
